responsibility: Declares lightweight helper builders for canonical ranges used by GCC’s value-range code, especially boolean and sign-class ranges. In addition to the basic zero/nonzero/positive/negative factory functions implemented in range.cc, it defines inline constructors for boolean true, false, and true-or-false iranges so range operators and VRP simplifiers can create standard predicate result ranges cheaply.
same_name_distinction: Declares the lightweight canonical-range helper API and adds inline boolean range constructors such as true, false, and true-or-false; unlike gcc/range.cc it is the declaration/inline helper side, and unlike gcc/range-op.h it is not the operator-reasoning interface.
